System

GAS ownership, attributes, costs and prediction

Use one Gameplay Ability System stack for health, mana, stamina, abilities, costs, cooldowns and effects. A player's ASC lives on PlayerState during one zone session; the current body is its avatar. An ordinary enemy owns its ASC on its Character.

Scope and player interaction

Use one Gameplay Ability System stack for health, mana, stamina, abilities, costs, cooldowns and effects. A player's ASC lives on PlayerState during one zone session; the current body is its avatar. An ordinary enemy owns its ASC on its Character.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase07committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Uninitialized → Ready → AbilityPending → Casting → Channeling → Recovery → Interrupted → Dead

WBP_ActionBar observes results from URPGAbilitySystemComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_CombatRules_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
AttributeSet: Health/MaxHealth, Mana/MaxMana, Stamina/MaxStamina, Power, Armor and resistance attributes
AbilitySpec handles: transient per ASC, not durable skill IDs
GrantedAbilityIds and purchased talents: durable definitions reconstructed after transfer
OwnerActor=PlayerState; AvatarActor=current PlayerCharacter; enemy owner/avatar=enemy
PredictionKey: GAS mechanism for supported predicted actions, not an economic command ID
LongCooldownExpiryUtc: durable policy for cooldowns that must not reset on zone change
ActionSequenceId: compact presentation identity distinct from a database receipt

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGAbilitySystemComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_ActionBarLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
InitializeAbilityActorInfo(Owner, Avatar) -> Ready|MissingOwner; project lifecycle wrapper around inspected GAS API
GrantBuildAbilities(BuildRevision) -> Granted|InvalidDefinition; server only, idempotent by current grant set
RequestAbility(AbilityInputTag, TargetIntent) -> Predicted|Rejected; local input plus server validation
CancelActions(Reason, MatchingSequence) -> Canceled; authoritative cancellation
ObserveAttributes() -> ReadOnlySnapshotAndDelegates; UI subscriber

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. On server possession, obtain the PlayerState ASC, validate hydrated build, initialize actor info with PlayerState as owner and Character as avatar, then apply default attributes and granted abilities once.
  2. On the owning client, PlayerState replication and possession readiness both call one guarded initialization path. Do not assume BeginPlay/OnRep order; rebind after respawn and clear old avatar delegates.
  3. Input tags resolve to granted ability specs. Use supported GAS local prediction for responsiveness, while the server rechecks costs, tags, target/range/LOS and cooldown.
  4. Server commits accepted GAS cost/cooldown and applies effects. Rejected predictions are reconciled by GAS and the project's UI/visual observer; never maintain a second manually predicted health balance.
  5. ASC delegates produce read-only attribute updates and semantic action cues for PaperZD; no PlayMontageAndWait dependency is assumed for sprites.
  6. On death cancel transient abilities and reinitialize the new avatar; on cross-server transfer create a new ASC and rebuild from durable definition IDs, not serialized object pointers/spec handles. Persist selected long cooldown expiries under a declared policy.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Enable Gameplay Ability System and Gameplay Tags dependencies in the C++ project. Add the needed GameplayAbilities, GameplayTags and GameplayTasks module dependencies using the installed engine conventions.
  2. Define URPGAttributeSet and URPGAbilitySystemComponent; PlayerState owns both and the Character implements IAbilitySystemInterface by returning that same ASC. Do not add another player ASC to the pawn.
  3. Create DA_CombatRules_Default and the initial GE_DefaultAttributes, GE_Damage, GE_Healing, GE_Cost and GE_Cooldown assets from their intended GAS bases. Separate authored effects from live active-effect state.
  4. Implement server possession and owning-client replicated-PlayerState readiness hooks. Check InitAbilityActorInfo and related API signatures in the installed 5.8.3 headers before compiling.
  5. Configure owner/public effect replication deliberately and measure PlayerState update rates; a common mixed-mode choice is only adopted after its owner-chain requirements are verified.
  6. Reopen BP_PlayerCharacter movement adapters to consume the ASC's stamina; reopen WBP_HUD and WBP_ActionBar to bind attribute/cooldown delegates and display server rejection text.

Reopen Phase07 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / Character_A / Enemy_Dummy. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Respawn twice -> exactly one ability grant set and one set of UI delegates.
Predicted cast with insufficient server mana -> rejection restores local presentation/cost expectation; no enemy damage.
PlayerState arrives after pawn -> HUD waits, then binds once; no null ASC access.
Zone transfer during cast -> cast canceled; a long cooldown does not reset merely because a new ASC is created.
Remove all sprite assets -> server costs/cooldowns/hits still work.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Initial health 100, mana 100, stamina 100 are fixtures, not class balance. No global cooldown initially; selected abilities may share an authored cooldown tag. Test update frequency rather than copying a default from another project.

Diagnostics show ASC owner/avatar, granted definition IDs, active tags, prediction rejection and attribute revision. GAS is not an inventory, quest, authentication or persistence service.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
